synopsis: ISO 13849-2:2012 lists simulation, including software simulation of faults, among its validation methods, but simulation is only one method among several accepted by the cited heavy-machinery standards [f12030, f10294]. The booklet recommends using the ISO 13849-2 validation plan as a structural source for the heavy off-road collision-mitigation validation plan [f9986]. The 2012 edition remains current while the standard is under revision; an Edition 3 Draft International Standard was issued in 2026 [f9766, f15054]. The plan should allow for re-baselining because ISO 13849-2 and related standards are being revised in 2025–2026, but the booklet did not review the Edition 3 draft wording, leaving its implications unassessed [f10369, f9768].
